The '''Monarc C-4 hyperdrive''' was a class 1.0 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] made by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated]] that propelled the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]].
